scope: Unscored synthetic cancellation attribution only; exact same 150 ms gate retained and failed. No instrumentation or driver costs subtracted.
limitations: One transient instrumented run does not establish a production timing pass. Large pre-map stalls were reproduced and attributed to HistoryStore work after SQLite open, overlapping a previous operation commit; the permission/PRAGMA boundary is not independently split.
Clock uses Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC across processes; all fixed trace write/lock costs remain included.
surface.initial_paint labels idle drag state, not necessarily first actual paint. UpdateRequest return is a Qt event boundary, not compositor presentation.
Synchronous driver X11 query intervals overlap application/native waits. They cannot be subtracted or treated as independent additive app-versus-observer costs.
